name: smwgraphics-shock-value-cave
title: Shock Value - Cave
description:
Now I've also gotten into graphics.

The following graphics were originally planned for use in Colossus first, but a public release was done first since I changed my mind.

What follows is a mineshaft level, in which the minecart tracks glow (supply your own ExAnimation), and could be set to act like lava (for instant kill), or made to be safe ground.
